changes: Adds Experience Layer Phase 1a module set: core/experience-layer-types.ts (leaf types), core/learning-store.ts (atomic read/write of .lattice/learning/finding-signals.json), core/finding-signals.ts (pure deriveFindingSignals + deriveFindingSignalsFromStore adapter reading via store.readFindings). Registers .lattice/learning/* as materialHash:exclude/volatile in runtime-artifact-registry. Adds hermetic smoke (21 checks) + npm script test:experience-layer-finding-signals. Zero outward imports except finding-signals->./store.js (the read port). No gate/CLI/injection changes.
usage: Inert foundation (no CLI yet). Run the proof: npm --prefix packages/main run test:experience-layer-finding-signals (=> 'smoke passed'). deriveFindingSignals(findings, {now}) and deriveFindingSignalsFromStore(store, projectRoot) are the entry points future phases call.
expectedOutcome: npm --prefix packages/main run test:experience-layer-finding-signals prints 'smoke passed' (TOTAL 21 | PASS 21 | FAIL 0); the committed verifier prints TOTAL 30 | PASS 30 | FAIL 0; build clean; writing finding-signals.json leaves currentMaterialHash unchanged.

outcomeDiff: No difference — engine + gate-safety foundation delivered exactly as planned; the one finding (F-001 concurrency coverage) was fixed and re-reviewed clean.
limitations: Inert by design: derives signals but nothing consumes them until Phase 1.5 (hint injection). Without Phase 1b enums (resolutionType/dismissReasonType/signatureTag) on real findings, signalScore is conservatively 0 and grouping is coarse (category+fileKind) — the engine reads those optional fields forward-compatibly. deriveFindingSignalsFromStore takes an explicit projectRoot (StoryStore exposes no projectRoot accessor).
pitfalls: store.ts is a flat sibling in core/, so the port import is ./store.js (not ../store.js). The derived cache MUST be registered materialHash:exclude or it pollutes gates. Editing the smoke (a tracked source file) changes materialHash and stales reviews+evidence -> a fresh REVIEW round is required after any smoke fix. Pin timestamps in pure derivation (no Date.now) for deterministic output.
